[[File:Tapani_balance_of_power.png|thumb|right|250px|Balance of power diagram showing control by the Mecetti-Reena-Calipsa coalition]]

The '''Mecetti-Reena-Calipsa coalition''' was an alliance between three [[Tapani Noble Houses]], [[House Mecetti|Mecetti]], [[House Reena/Legends|Reena]] and [[House Calipsa|Calipsa]], that held the balance of power in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] [[Great Council (Tapani Federation)|Great Council]] for at least twenty years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
